lines: Did you hear the horns last night?
I did. I hid under the bed till the bell stopped.
The watch says they came from the east road.
Then I'm not taking the east road to market.
If the raiders come again, I'm ready.
Ready? You were behind the well, {0}.
We were all behind the well.
We should build the walls higher.
With what stone? The mason's still on the chapel steps.
Then the chapel can wait. Walls first.
You tell him. I'll hold the ladder.
My cousin in the next village lost two sheep to raiders.
Only two? They took the whole barn at Millbrook.
Walking the wall again. Round and round.
I asked. It just looked at me.
It gave me a flower once.
Is it me, or is {golem} following me?
It follows everyone who drops bread.
I do drop a lot of bread.
It lets them. Gentle as a lamb.
Gentle till a zombie shows up.
Then it's not gentle at all. Good.
A traveller paid me in buttons today.
Eight emeralds for a stone pickaxe. Can you believe it?
The smith. He said it was a lucky one.
It broke on the first block.
The prices at the stall went up again.
Flour's short. The mill's been slow.
That stranger bought every arrow I had.
Then he sold them back to me cheaper.
It is. The bread smells good from here.
Are you going to the service on market day?
Wouldn't miss it. The cleric does the voices.
For the old stories. Very dramatic.
The new folk at the end of the road seem nice.
You were facing the wrong way, {3}.
Your knee was wrong last week.
My knee is never wrong. The sky was.
Did you see who walked {2} home last night?
You can't say that and not say!
I think the miller's sweet on someone.
Why did the creeper cross the road?
To get to the other... ssssside.
What do you call a sheep with no legs?
I told the golem a joke.
How does a skeleton call its friends?
The innkeeper's cider is strong tonight.
Is that why the bench is moving?
You said that two rounds ago.
And I meant it every time.
You let your goats into my garden again!
Your hammering kept me up all night.
The iron doesn't wait for you.
Then you've had it long enough.
I saved you the last apple.
Walk with me to the well later?
